content.title: NXT Stand & Deliver Card, Start Time & How to Watch
content.text: Before NXT Stand & Deliver, Ryan Wohl details the full card and viewing information for the event. Tonight, NXT airs its annual Stand & Deliver premium live event! opens in a new tabThis is the sixth Stand & Deliver event for NXT, but the first time that it is not attached to WrestleMania weekend. Stand & Deliver is taking place in St. Louis, Missouri, at The Factory at The District. Check out the full 2026 NXT Stand & Deliver match card with viewing information. NXT Stand & Deliver Match Card Joe Hendry (c) vs. Ricky Saints vs. Tony D’Angelo vs. Ethan Page — NXT Championship Match Jacy Jayne (c) vs. Kendal Grey vs. Lola Vice — NXT Women’s Championship Match Myles Borne (c) vs. Johnny Gargano — NXT North American Championship Match Tatum Paxley (c) vs. Blake Monroe — NXT Women’s North American Championship Match: The Vanity Project (c) vs. Los Americanos — NXT Tag Team Championship Match Sol Ruca vs. Zaria — Singles Match Hank & Tank, Shiloh Hill, Eli Knight & Wren Sinclair vs. BirthRight — Mixed 10-Person Tag Team Match How to Watch NXT Stand & Deliver You can watch NXT Stand & Deliver at 7:00 p.m. ET on WWE’s YouTube channel in the United States. The Countdown to Stand & Deliver begins at 6:00 p.m. ET on WWE’s YouTube channel and its social media platforms. NXT Stand & Deliver: FAQ Where will NXT Stand & Deliver take place? Stand & Deliver is taking place in St. Louis, Missouri, at The Factory at The District. What time does the 2026 NXT Stand & Deliver start? The main card for the NXT Stand & Deliver begins at 7:00 p.m. ET. How can I watch Stand & Deliver? Fans in the U.S. can view this event live on WWE’s YouTube channel.
